name: Theodora
source:
A female warrior with the honor of saving the world. She is now retired, but her skills have not diminished.

She married a civilian and became a mother of one child, but her husband passed away a few years ago.

She is raising her son “Granz” by herself.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_139.html#character]official site[/url]]
